faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is 19-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E./M.E/M.Tech in ECE/ETC/EE discipline with a valid GATE score and two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years, which is relaxable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is up to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on the candidate's qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is online. Candidates need to apply through the official IIT Kharagpur website.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key skills required for this role?
faq.answer: Strong fundamental knowledge in Digital Communication, Digital Signal Processing, Wireless Communication, Probability, random process, Linear Algebra, and proficiency in MATLAB or C/C++ or Python are required.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is IIT/SRIC/R/VJA/2026/103.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links for the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
